description: Use when you need the full public board for one NFL week (regular season weeks 1 to 18). Returns every game, including the published call, note, chip, hours, and roof. Pass weekId (YYYY-wNN) or omit it for the current week, the same week as the homepage. After the last Week 18 kickoff window the current week stays on 18.

weekId.description: Week id YYYY-wNN, for example 2026-w04. Regular season weeks are 1–18. Omit for the current week.

name: get_week_board
title: Week board
